title: Auto Refill & Medication Sync Program Schedule: Enrollment Requirements
content:
Each of the six Auto Refill & Medication Sync programs sets its own entry requirements for a prescription and its own capacity. The figures below apply per program; the Prescriptions charter decides which switches a prescription's handling class carries, and Delivery & Pickup Services holds the patient's delivery plan.

## Schedule of entry requirements

| Program | Prescriptions charter switch the class must have set to true | Class must allow a 90-day supply | Dispensed fills of the prescription at Kestrel needed before enrollment | Delivery plan required | Enrollment fee | Most prescriptions of one patient enrolled in this program at once |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day | Auto Refill eligible | No | 0 | No | $0.00 | 20 |
| Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day | Auto Refill eligible | Yes | 1 | No | $0.00 | 20 |
| Kestrel Med Sync Monthly | Med Sync eligible | No | 1 | No | $0.00 | 15 |
| Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day | Med Sync eligible | Yes | 1 | No | $0.00 | 15 |
| Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging | adherence packaging eligible | No | 1 | No | $0.00 | 10 |
| Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill | Auto Refill eligible | Yes | 1 | Yes | $0.00 | 20 |

## What each column records

- **Eligibility switch** — the one switch of the Prescriptions charter, among Auto Refill eligible, Med Sync eligible and adherence packaging eligible, that the prescription's handling class must have set to true for this program.
- **90-day supply** — whether the prescription's class must allow a 90-day supply for this program.
- **Prior fills** — the number of dispensed fills of the prescription at Kestrel needed before enrollment, as a whole number.
- **Delivery plan** — whether the patient must hold a delivery plan in enrolled or active status for this program.
- **Enrollment fee** — the fee to enroll, in US dollars.
- **Capacity** — the most prescriptions of one patient enrolled in this program at once, as a whole number.

## The schedule read by program family

- The three programs keyed to the Auto Refill eligible switch (Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day, Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day, Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill) each hold up to 20 prescriptions of one patient; only Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill lists a delivery plan requirement, and only Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day lists 0 prior fills.
- The two programs keyed to the Med Sync eligible switch hold up to 15 prescriptions each; of the two, only Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day lists the 90-day supply requirement.
- Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging is the only program keyed to the adherence packaging eligible switch and holds up to 10 prescriptions.
- Every program lists an enrollment fee of $0.00.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical example)

A hypothetical prescription has never been dispensed at Kestrel, so its prior fills at Kestrel number 0. On the prior-fills column alone, Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day is the only program whose figure (0) that count reaches; each other program lists 1. The other columns are read in the same way, one program at a time.
